testCases.title: Page loads successfully after login
testCases.expectedResult: Electricity module page loads with header, navigation elements, and content area visible

testCases.title: Room-wise electricity data displays correctly
preconditions: Rooms have existing electricity records for current month
steps: Locate room-wise electricity table or list
Verify each room shows current month charges
Verify meter readings are visible for each room
testCases.expectedResult: All rooms with electricity usage display correct room number, current month charges, meter readings, and usage dates

testCases.title: Navigation between electricity and other modules
steps: Click on Rooms module link in navigation
Click back on Electricity module link
Verify return to /electricity with data intact
testCases.expectedResult: User can navigate to other modules and return to electricity page without losing state or encountering errors

testCases.title: View detailed room electricity breakdown
preconditions: At least one room has electricity records
steps: Click on a specific room entry to view details
Verify detailed view shows historical meter readings
testCases.expectedResult: Detailed view opens showing complete electricity history for the selected room including past readings and charges

testCases.title: Empty state displays when no electricity records exist
steps: Check for empty state message or illustration
testCases.expectedResult: Page displays appropriate empty state message indicating no electricity records found, with option to add records

testCases.title: Meter reading with negative or invalid value
preconditions: User has permission to edit meter readings
steps: Select a room with editable meter reading
Enter a negative number (e.g., -50) in meter reading field
testCases.expectedResult: System rejects negative meter reading with appropriate validation error message; form does not save invalid data
